s: Seder uzeman hagalat kelim ubo l' seipim: seder hagala: loqeach yora umartiach bah mayim umaknis letokah kol kelim hatztzerikim hagala bikli rishon. Ukeli gadol sheeno niknas kelal letokah — yaaseh sapa shel tit sabib lepiv kede sheyyeqabbel mayim rabbim veyaabru hammayim al kol sepato, veachar kak yemalleennu mayim al kol sepato veyartichem betoko etzel haesh, venimtza sheggam sepat hakkeli hugal al yede harotechim sheaberu al gabbayv. Veap al pi sheharotechin enan mitakkebin harbeh al sepat hakkeli, shemmiyyad hen zabin veyoredim mishsham derek hattit, mikkol maqom hare gam kol hashshana lo nitakkeb hechametz al gabbe sepat hakkeli velo nibla bo hechametz ella al yede nitzotzot hannittazim mehattabshil lispat hakkeli. Umikkol maqom, im lo yaaseh sapa lepiv kede sheyyaabru harotechin al sepato — en hagala ola lispato al yede nitzotzot hannittazin al gabbayv meharotechin shebbetoko, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma akshayv bishat hagala zo lo yaaleh nitzotzot al (kol) sepato, mah sheen ken haissur shennitbashshel betoko peamim harbeh — i epshar shello heela nitzotzot al (kol) sepato paam achat. Veim eno rotzeh laasot lo sapa — yemalleennu mayim heteb veyartichem betoko etzel haesh veyiqqach eben roteach o lappid esh veyashlikennu letok harotechin, umittok kak yartichu yoter veyigberu veyaalu al kol sepato:

(Uleachar shehigilo al yede sapa o al yede eben velappid — yishpok harotechin mittoko veyishtepennu bemayim qarim, veyachazor vimalleennu mayim veyartichem betoko veyagilennu kammishpat harishon al yede sapa o eben velappid esh im hu magil beereb pesach mishshaa chamishit vaelak vehakkeli hu ben yomo, kemo sheyyitbaer). Vekol zeh bikli shello nishtammesh bo chametz ella mittoko kederek tashmish kol hakkelim, ulekak hu nikshar al yede hagalat harotechin shebbetoko, di"keboleo kak poleto". Abal keli shennishtammesh chametz gam batztzad hachitzon shello, kegon keli sheshshoabin bo rotechin mikkeli rishon, veken qeara shemmekassin hailpas batztzad hachitzon shellah — enan niksharin al yede hagalat harotechin shemmittokan, ella tzarik lehaknisan kullam letok yora gedola, kede sheyyaaleh harotechim al tzad hachitzon shellahem:

Ukeshemmaknis hakkelim layyora — tzarik lizzaher sheyyihyu hammayim maalin reticha, dehaynu ababuot, bishat kenisat hakkelim letokam, shehahagala enah ella berotechin shemmaalin ababuot, abal lo bechammin ap al pi shehayyad soledet bo. Veim maknis layyora kelim harbeh zeh achar zeh uregilut keshemmaknisin keli echad letok harotechin miyyad nachim meretichatam — tzarik lehamtin shello yaknis keli hashsheniyya ad yashubu hammayim veyaalu ababuot, veken yamtin behaknasat kol keli ukeli. Umeod tzarik lehizzaher bazeh, sheim lo nizhar bazeh — hare hipsid hahagala legamre. Abal haolam enan nizharin bazeh, veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut, lepi sheen derek lehagil raq kappot sherob tashmishan hu bikli sheni, uqearot sherob tashmishan hu al yede eruy mikkeli rishon, vekosot sherob tashmishan hu betzonen, vekelim hallalu vekayyotze bahem en tzarik lehagilan berotechin, ella day lahem bechammin shehayyad soledet bo. Abal kelim sherob tashmishan hu al yede chom keli rishon — apillu bediabad oserin et hachammin shennishtammeshu bahem, im higilan bechammin shello heelu reticha:

Yesh matzrikin lehashhot hakkelim betok harotechin beomed haddaat, bikde sheyyaplitu kol giulam. Velo nahagu ken, uminhagan shel yisrael tora hu, ki mi yodea leshaer matay yaplit hakkeli kol giulo, sheim banu lomar sheyyashheh oto kol kak berotechin kederek sheshshaha bo haissur keshennibla bo — lo hayeta hagala achat moelet lo kelal, shehare nishtammesh bo issur zeh kamma yamim, vehaek yiplot kullo behagala achat? Ella vadday kak qibbelu chakamim shebbehagala achat hu polet et hakkol, veim ken en chilluq ben im yishheh harbeh berotechin o im yotziennu miyyad. Umikkol maqom, tob lehashhoto meat mizzeer, bikde sheyyihyeh penay leharotechin likkanes letok obi hakkeli ulehaplit haggiul mishsham, sheap shehappelita naaset kerega, mikkol maqom tzarik qetzat shehiyya kede kenisat harotechin letok obi hakkeli ukede yetziat haggiul lachutz:

Uleachar hagalat kol keli ukeli nahagu kol yisrael leshotpo tekep umiyyad bemayim qarim, kede shello yibla millikluk mayim rotechim sheal gabbayv, sheggiul pelitat hakkeli nitareb berotechin. Veap shekkebar nitbattel betokam beshishshim, ap al pi ken nohagin lekattechilla lehaabiro meal gabbe hakkeli al yede shetipa betzonen:

Uleachar gemar hagalat hakkelim — yishpok harotechin shebbayyora hachutza, sheasur lehanot mehem lekattechilla, lepi sheggiul pelitat hakkelim meorab bahem. Veap al pi shennitbattel betokam beshishshim, mikkol maqom kevan shehammagil maknis hakkeli bayyadayim letok harotechim kede lehaplit haissur min hakkeli letok harotechin — hare zeh kimbattel issur betok hahetter beyadayim im yehaneh meharotechin shehaissur nitbattel bahem. Abal im lo yehaneh mehem — eno kimbattel issur beyadayim, kevan sheen kavvanato raq lehaplit haissur min hakkeli, velo lehanot mehammayim shehaissur niplat letokam. (Vaapillu im hakkelim hannigalim lo hayu bene yoman, shehaggiul hanniplat mehem hu noten taam lipgam — ap al pi ken en lehattir lehanot lekattechilla min hammayim shebbayyora, shello hittiru noten taam lipgam ella kesheabar ubishshel biqdera sheenah bat yomah, shehattabshil muttar baakila, abal lekattechilla asur lebashshel biqdera sheenah bat yomah, vezeh shemmaknis hakkeli bayyadayim letok hammayim kede lehaplit haissur happagum min hakkeli letok hammayim — hare zeh kimbashshel biqdera sheenah bat yomah im yehaneh min hammayim shehaissur happagum niplat letokam):

Vekol hakkelim apillu shulchanot vetebot hatztzerikin hagala — yesh lizzaher lahadicham uleshapshepam yapeh qodem hahagala, kede shello yihyeh dabuq bahem shum mashshehu issur beayin (abal meiqqar haddin setam kelim neqiyyim hem, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"h). Veachar kak yenaggebem yapeh mimme hahadacha sheal gabbehem shehem tzonenim, shello yetzannenu meat et me hahagala:

Hammagil kelim habbeluim mechametz leachar shehiggia zeman issur akilato, dehaynu beereb pesach mittechillat shaa h' vaelak — tzarik lehagil mittechilla et hayyora shemmagil bah et hakkelim, veyishpok et me hahagala lachutz veyishtepenna betzonen, veyartiach bah mayim acherim veyaknis betokah et hakkelim, sheim lo yagil hayyora mittechilla — hare hammayim shebbayyora neesarin mechamat hayyora, sheen bammayim shishshim keneged kol obi dopne hayyora veshuleha, vechozerin hammayim hanneesarim veoserin et hakkelim hannigalin betoko, sheppelitat hayyora shebbetok hammayim nibla bakkelim:

Vetzarik sheyyihyeh bammayim shebbayyora shishshim keneged kol hakkelim hannigalim betokam, sheim en bammayim shishshim keneged hakkelim — hare hammayim neesarin mechamat pelitat hakkelim, vechozerin veoserin et hakkelim, sheppelitat hakkelim shebbetok hammayim chozeret veniblaat bahem veosartan, kevan shello nitbattela beshishshim betok hammayim:

Vaapillu im eno magil kol hakkelim bebat achat ella magilan zeh achar zeh — lo day sheyyehe bemayim shishshim keneged kol keli ukeli bilbaddo, ella tzarik sheyyehe bahem shishshim keneged kullam beyachad, lepi sheggiul hanniplat mikkeli hab' o hag' — hare gam giul harishon chozer veneor umitztarep im giul hab' veg' veoserin et hammayim sheen bahem shishshim kenegdan, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"t ayyen sham:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehakkelim beshaa shemmagilan hem bene yoman mibbeliat haissur, abal im enan bene yoman — en tzarik sheyyihyeh bammayim shishshim apillu keneged keli echad mehem, shehaggiul hanniplat mehakkelim hu pagum, veap im chozer venibla bahem — hare hu noten taam lipgam, umuttar keshennaasa qodem happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z. Veap al pi sheqqodem shenniplat haggiul min hakkelim haya gam ken pagum veap al pi ken tzarik lehagilo ulehaplito min hakkeli middibre soperim gezera mishshum keli ben yomo, veim ken akshayv shehaggiul chazar venibla bahem — ma hoil kelum behagalato? Mikkol maqom, kevan shehaggiul beatzmo happagum muttar gamur hu apillu middibre soperim, hare yesh noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter, dehaynu taam pagum shehaya balua bakkeli qodem hahagala hu noten taam echad shel hetter, umimmennu niplat haggiul happagum letok hammayim hare noten taam b' shel hetter, veken hammayim chazeru venibleu bakkelim hare noten taam g' shel hetter, vehu muttar gamur ap beissure tora, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"h:

Veken im hayyora enah bat yomah — en tzarik lehagilah qodem hagalat hakkelim betokah, lepi sheyyesh kan g' notene taam shel hetter: min hechametz layyora, umin hayyora lammayim shebbetokah, umin hammayim lakkelim hannigalim, vehakkol shel hetter, kevan shehaggiul hu pagum:

Vekol zeh keshemmagil beereb pesach mishshaa h' vaelak. Veken apillu bekol yemot hashshana, im magil keli habbalua mishshear issure tora o issure dibre soperim — tzarik lizzaher shello yihyeh ben yomo, o sheyyehe bammayim shishshim kenegdo, veaz muttar lehagil apillu im magil kelim habbeluim meissur im kelim kesherim habbeluim mechametz, vaapillu im maknis layyora keli habbalua meissur qodem shemmaknis kelim hakkesherim o shemmaknisan beyachad bebat achat. Abal im magil kele hechametz qodem shaa h', ap im hayyora hu ben yomo — en tzarik lehagilo techilla, veken en tzarik sheyyihyeh bammayim shishshim keneged hakkelim ap im hem bene yoman, dekevan shehechametz hu muttar adayin baakila — hare yesh kan g' notene taam shel hetter qodem sheyyabo liklal issur, dehaynu qodem sheyyaggia zeman issuro, ulepikak eno chozer veneesar ap kesheyyaggia zeman issuro, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z.*[Veayyen sham sheap haoserim beb' notene taam modim beg' notene taam, mittaam hamboar sham. Veen haddabar domeh ledagim shennitbashshelu biqdera shel basar sheyyesh oserim leoklam bechalab, ap al pi sheyyesh g' notene taam: min habbasar laqqedera, umehaqqedera leharoteb shel dagim shebbetokah, umeharoteb laddagim, lepi shettaam qalush shel basar hammubla baddagim yesh bo chashibut taam qetzat, ki nibla okel beokel, shehaddagim reuyin laakila vehabbasar natan bahem taam lishbach, lekak asur leoklo bechalab im nitbashshelu biqdera shel basar. Abal taam qalush shel chametz shenniplat min hakkelim o min hayyora vechozer venibla bakkelim — eno chashub taam kelal kesheyyachazor veyiplot bepesach letok hattabshil]:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmagil kele chalab lebaddam o kele basar lebaddam, abal im magilam beyachad, dehaynu shettocheb otam bayyora bebat achat mammash — tzarik lizzaher sheyyihyeh bammayim shishshim keneged echad mehem, o sheyyihyeh echad mehem eno ben yomo, sheim shenehen hen bene yoman veen bammayim shishshim keneged echad mehem — hare neesru hammayim mechamat pelitat habbasar upelitat hechalab hamorebet bahem, vechozerin veoserin et hakkelim veet hayyora. Abal kesheeno magilan beyachad, ap al pi shemmagilan beyora achat ella shemmaknisan zeh achar zeh — lo neesru hammayim kelal, lepi sheyyesh kan noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter qodem sheyyabo liklal issur, dehaynu min habbasar o hechalab lakkeli umin hakkeli lehammayim shebbayyora, vaadayin hakkol hetter, kevan sheadayin lo niplat letok hammayim ella taam chalab lebaddo o taam basar lebaddo:

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal kebar nahagu bimdinot ellu lehachamir lehagil hayyora techilla ap im enah bat yomah umagil betokah qodem shaa h'. Veken nahagu shello lehagil shum keli keshehu ben yomo ap shehu yechidi veyesh bammayim yoter mishshishshim kenegdo. Vaapillu rotzeh lehagilo qodem shaa h' — lo yagilennu keshehu ben yomo, gezera shemma yitu lehagil keli habbalua mishshear issure tora keshehu ben yomo, velo yedaqdequ im yesh bammayim shishshim kenegdo, veyachzeru hammayim veyibbaleu bakkeli veyaasru otam im en bahem shishshim kenegdo, shehare en kan noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter ella shel issur habbalua bakkeli:

Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim: ap keshemmagil mishshaa h' vaelak — en tzarik lehagil hayyora techilla ap shehi bat yomah, veken en tzarik sheyyehe bammayim shishshim keneged hakkelim ap im hem bene yoman, lepi shekkol zeman shehakkelim terudim liplot haggiul habbalua bahem — enan boleim kelum mehaggiul hanniplat mehem velo hen mehaggiul hanniplat min hayyora, shemmechamat tirdatam liplot en bahem koach libloa. Raq shetztzarik hu lehizzaher shello yashheh hakkelim betok hayyora yoter midday, ella yashheh otam sham beomed haddaat bikde sheyyaplitu kol giulam, veyotziem miyyad, sheim yashheh otam sham leachar shehiplitu kol giulam — hare hem chozerin ubolein miggiul hanniplat mehem kebar o min giul hanniplat min hayyora, dekevan sheenam terudin od liplot — hare hem chozerin ubolein, veneesarin im hem bene yoman veen bammayim shishshim kenegdan, o im hayyora hi bat yomah ap al pi sheyyesh bammayim shishshim kenegdan:

Veken tzarik lizzaher shello lehagil beyachad kelim shennibla bahem issur merubbeh im kelim shennibla bahem issur muat, kegon kappot sherob tashmishan bikli sheni, veen tzarik lomar kosot sherob tashmishan betzonen — lo yagilennu bebat achat im qearot sherob tashmishan al yede eruy mikkeli rishon, veen tzarik lomar im qederot shel mattakot o im kappot shemmegisin bahem haqqedera (ella mittechilla yaknis layyora hakkelim shebbeliatan muetet, veachar kak yaknis hakkelim shebbeliatan merubba) shemmemaharin liplot giul habbalua mehem, uleachar sheppaletu kol giulam sheenam terudin od liplot — hare hem chozerin ubolein giul hanniplat mikkeli shebbeliatan merubba. Veken tzarik lizzaher shello lehagil miqtzat keli echad b' peamim, kegon keshemmagil kelim gedolim shei epshar lehaknis kol hakkeli betok hayyora bebat achat — lo yegalgelo bayyad sabib bammayim, shello yachazor veyaknis bammayim mimmiqtzat shekkebar hugal paam achat upalat kebar kol giulo, veakshayv keshechozer umakniso bammayim — hu chozer ubolea giul sheppalat kebar, o giul shenniplat mishshear kelim shehugalu kebar, o giul shenniplat mehayyora, kevan sheakshayv eno tarud od liplot. Ella ketzad yaaseh? Yaknis bammayim chatzi hakkeli o shelishito veyotziennu leachar sheppalat giulo, veyachazor veyaknis tzad hashsheni, vitzamtzem kepi yekolto shello yaknis miqtzat echad paamayim:

Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik lizzaher bekol zeh, ap al pi shemmagil mishshaa h' vaelak vehakkelim hem bene yoman veen bammayim shishshim kenegdan vehayyora hi gam ken bat yomah, veen chosheshin shemma yachzeru veyibleu mehaggiul sheppaletu o mehaggiul shenniplat mehayyora, lepi sheameru chaza"l shetteba harotechin libloa velo liplot mah shebbaleu, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"b, veken ellu harotechin shebbayyora bolein haggiul hanniplat mehakkelim umin hayyora veenan poletin et haggiul shebbaleu, dehaynu sheenan mabliin oto betok hakkelim kol zeman shehen rotechin, dehaynu shemmaalin reticha vaababuot. Ulepikak im qadam vehotzi et hakkelim min hayyora beod sheharotechin maalin reticha — hare lo nibla behakkelim shum giul. Abal im hotzi leachar shennachu meretichatan ap al pi shehayyad soledet bo — hare chazeru hakkelim ubaleu giul shenniplat mehem o mehayyora, lekak tzarik lachazor ulehartiach hammayim veyagil hakkelim paam shenit, veyotziem terem sheyyanuchu hammayim meretichatan:

Ulepi b' sebarot ellu haacharonot — muttar lehagil kelim ap betok happesach (perush bechullo shel moed, abal beyom tob en lehakshir kelim, ella al derek sheyyitbaer besiman tq"t ayyen sham). Abal lepi sebara harishona, kevan sheen taqqana lehagala ella al yede bittul beshishshim o al yede hetter noten taam lipgam, im ken millel t"v shehechametz asur bemashshehu vegam noten taam lipgam asur lepi minhagenu — en lehakshir shum keli ella al yede libbun beur, sheaz haissur nisrap venikleh legamre, veen lachosh bo shemma yachazor veyibbala bakkeli:

Uleinyan pesaq halaka — haiqqar kassebara harishona, shertichat hammayim enah meakkebet et hakkelim millibloa, vegam tirdat pelitat hakkelim enah meakkabtan millibloa (et haggiul, shehu rak venisrak venidbaq venibla bakkeli, shehare hu domeh letzir shehu nibla babbasar ap keshehabbasar tarud liplot et damo, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman a'). Veod, sheppelitat hakkelim nigmeret bimhera miyyad shemmaknisan lammayim kemo shennitbaer, veim mashheh otam bammayim meat yoter — yesh lachosh shemma chazeru ubaleu mah sheppaletu o mah sheppolta hayyora. Veod, shekkeshemmotzi hakkelim mehayyora vehen meluklakin bemayim chammin — yesh lachosh shemma berega zo baleu mimmayim hallalu sheal gabbehen (shebberega zo enan terudin liplot). Lepikak, en hagala moelet mishshaa h' vaelak, ella im ken yesh bammayim shishshim keneged hakkelim im hem bene yoman. Veim hayyora hi bat yomah — tzarik lehagilah techilla, kemo shennitbaer lepi sebara harishona:

Umikkol maqom, yesh lehachamir velachosh gam lassebarot haacharonot, ulepikak ap im hayyora vehakkelim enan bene yoman vegam yesh bammayim shishshim keneged hakkelim — yizzaher bekol mah shetztzarik lizzaher lepi sebara hashsheniyya ubemah shetztzarik lizzaher lepi sebara shelishit. Dehaynu, sheyyizzaher shello lehagil kelim shebbeliatam muetet im kelim shebbeliatam merubba, veshello lehagil miqtzat keli shette peamim, veshello lehashhot hakkelim yoter midday shello yachzeru veyibleu haggiul sheppaletu. Veap al pi shezzeh haggiul hu noten taam lipgam, vegam yesh bammayim shishshim kenegdo, mikkol maqom im lo yizzaher baddebarim hallalu — hare zeh kemablia haggiul beyadayim betok hakkelim lepi sebara hashsheniyya (shekkol zeman shehakkelim terudim liplot enan boleim kelum, umechamat sheeno nizhar yibleu), ulekattechilla bevadday en lehablio betok hakkelim, shehare hammayim shebbayyora asurin lehanot mehem lekattechilla mechamat shehaggiul balua bahem kemo shennitbaer, vekelim hallalu shehu rotzeh lehanot mehem ulehishtammesh bahem ek yablia bahem et haggiul? Veken yizzaher shello lehashhot hakkelim ad sheyyanuchu hammayim meretichatam, shekkeshemmashheh otan bemayim chammim sheenan rotechin — hare zeh kemablia bahem haggiul beyadayim lepi sebara hashshelishit. Umittaam zeh tzarik lizzaher lekattechilla shello lehaknis hakkelim ad shehammayim yaalu reticha, shekkeshemmaknisam qodem laken yesh lachosh sheyyaplitu veyachzeru veyabliu. Veap sheen haddabar barur sheyyabliu mah sheyyaplitu, veepshar shello yaspiqu liplot velibloa qodem sheyyartichu hammayim, mikkol maqom kevan shellekattechilla en lehablia bahem haggiul ap shehu noten taam lipgam veyesh bammayim shishshim kenegdo, im ken kol mah sheepshar lo letaqqen shello yablia kelum tzarik hu letaqqen. Vekevan shellepi sebara hashshelishit im yizzaher lehaknis hakkelim layyora keshehammayim rotechin kebar ulehotziam mehayyora beod shehammayim hem rotechin bevadday lo yabliu kelum, veim lo yizzaher bekak epshar sheyyibleu — tzarik hu lizzaher lekattechilla ulehagil beinyan shebbevadday lo yibleu kelum. Veap al pi sheap im yibleu qodem retichat hammayim yaplitu achar kak kesheyyartichu hammayim veshub lo yibleu kesheyyizzaher lehotziam mehayyora terem sheyyanuchu hammayim meretichatam, mikkol maqom lekattechilla tzarik letaqqen beinyan shello yabliu kelal, sheen lehablia issur lekattechilla al daat sheyyagilo veyaplito achar kak. Vekevan shetztzarik lehizzaher bekol debarim hallalu keshemmagil mishshaa h' vaelak, lepikak tob lo laadam sheyyizzaher lehagil qodem shaa h', kede shello yitztarek lizzaher uledaqdeq bekol debarim hallalu. Veyesh (mehamdaqdeqim) shennohagin lehagil g' yamim qodem happesach:

Veim rotzeh lehishtammesh bepesach beyora zo shehigil bah hakkelim qodem shaa h', o apillu achar shaa h' ella shello hayu hakkelim bene yoman, o apillu hayu bene yoman ella shehaya bammayim shishshim kenegdan — eno tzarik lachazor ulehagil et hayyora achar hagalat hakkelim betokah im higilah kebar qodem hagalat hakkelim, shehare haggiul shennibla bah mippelitat hakkelim kebar nitbattel bammayim beshishshim, o shehu noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter, kemo shennitbaer. Umikkol maqom, im beshaa shehigil et hayyora battechilla hayeta bat yomah vehigilah mishshaa h' vaelak — tzarik lachazor ulehagilah paam shenit ap im lo hayu hakkelim bene yoman vehaya bammayim shishshim kenegdan (veap im eno rotzeh kelal lehagil betokah kelim — tzarik lehagilah b' peamim) lehakshirah lehishtammesh bah bepesach, lepi shekkeshehigilah battechilla chazeru hammayim venibleu bah vaasaruha, shehare haggiul shenniplat min hayyora lo nitbattel bammayim beshishshim kemo shennitbaer lemala, vegam eno noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter, kevan shehu ben yomo ukebar higgia zeman issur hechametz bishat hagala, ella lepi shehammayim hallalu shechazeru venibleu bayyora en kol gupan mammashut issur, veen bahem issur ella lepi cheshbon, dehaynu lepi erek giul pelitat kol gup hayyora neged kol hammayim shebbayyora, kegon im yesh bekol hammayim shebbayyora eser peamim kemo kol gup hayyora, yesh gam ken bammayim hallalu shechazeru venibleu bayyora eser chalaqim shel mayim hammuttarim shehayu bayyora, vecheleq achad asar hu haggiul shenniplat mehayyora lammayim, lepikak keshechozer umagil hayyora paam b' — hare chozer veniplat mimmenna haggiul shechazar venibla betokah behagala rishona veakshayv hu mitbattel bammayim shebbayyora beyoter mishshishshim. Veap shechozer venibla bayyora gam behagala zo, mikkol maqom eno oser et hayyora, kevan shekkebar nitbattel beshishshim. Ulepi taam zeh, keshemmagilah b' peamim qodem hagalat hakkelim betokah — day bekak. Abal nahagu lehachamir velachazor ulehagil hayyora achar hagalat hakkelim betokah kede lehishtammesh bah bepesach ap im lo hayu hakkelim bene yoman vehigilam betokah qodem shaa h' vegam hayyora lo hayeta bat yomah bishat hagalata:

Umikkol maqom, im hayu bammayim shishshim keneged hakkelim — en machamirin lachazor ulehagil hayyora. Lepikak, muttar lehagil keli habbalua meissur betok qedera keshera melea rotechin im yesh bahem shishshim keneged hakkeli shemmagil (raq sheyyizzaher lishpok harotechin shebbaqqedera, sheasur lehanot mehem kemo shennitbaer):

Veap im lo hayu bammayim shebbayyora shishshim keneged hakkelim — en tzarik lishpok hammayim hachutza velachazor ulemalleotah mayim acherim lehagilah, ella beod mayim rotechin hallalu betokah leachar gemar hagalat hakkelim maknis letok hammayim eben melubban o lappid boer, umittok kak yartichu hammayim beyoter veyigberu veyaalu al sepat hayyora, vezo hi hagalatah, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Lo yanniach kelim harbeh letok sal echad menuqqab o letok sebaka achat veyagilem yachad, ella im ken hem munnachim sham berevach sheenam nogein zeh bazeh, lepi shebbimqom negiatam en hagala ola sham. Veap al pi shehammayim maggiim sham, shehare leinyan tebila en negia zo chashuba chatzitza, mikkol maqom leinyan hagala tzarik shertichat hammayim yaggiu bekol shetach hakkeli, ubimqom negiatam en hareticha ola yapeh. (Abal betok keli sheeno menuqqab lo yagil apillu keli echad ap al pi shehu tzap betoko veen nogein zeh bazeh, ella im ken mashheh otam betok hayyora keshiur shennitbaer besiman tn"a, ayyen sham):

Im ochez et hakkeli betok harotechin al yede tzebat — tzarik legalgel meat et hakkeli, dehaynu sheyyiptach et hatztzebat betok harotechin veyochaz hakkeli bemaqom acher kede sheyyaalu harotechin al meqom achizat hatztzebat, ulepikak yoter tob lehagil bisbaka o besal menuqqab:

Chamme teberya dinam kechamme haur lehachamir, kegon leinyan belia, sheim nishtammesh issur bikli al yede chamme teberya — neesar hakkeli. Abal en magilin betokam kelim shenneesru al yede chamme haur, apillu lo neesru ella al yede chom keli sheni, lepi shechamme teberya enan toledot haur, ukebar ameru: "keboleo kak poleto", mah boleo al yede toledot haur — ap poleto al yede toledot haur. Abal im lo neesru raq al yede chamme teberya — yakol lehagilam al yadam, vekol shekken al yede chamme haur:

En magilin beshum mashqeh raq bemayim, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheshshear mashqim en bahem koach lehaplit kol haggiul kemo hammayim, umayim hamorabim im eper (sheqqorin lv"g) dinam kishar mashqim, shehaeper mebattel koach hammayim. Ubediabad sheabar vehigil bahem o bishar mashqin — olta lahem hagala:
Im higil harbeh kelim bayyora ad shemmerob pelitat hakkelim naasu hammayim ketzir — en lehagil od beotan hammayim:
Ulepi sherabbu meod haddiqduqim behilkot hagala veen hakkol beqiin bahem, lepikak rauy venakon shebbaal tora habbaqi behilkot hagala hu yagil et hakkelim, velo kemo shennohagin akshayv:
